_about: Per-metric change thresholds shared by the Nightly Kernel Checks page (the
THRESHOLDS constant in index.html, which test_kernel_checks_page.py keeps
equal to this file) and pr_report.py. A change of at least `pct` percent of
the previous value counts: the page colors it, the report lists it. With
`mad`, it must also exceed that many times the larger of the two runs' median
absolute deviations (the ± at the start of a kernel row's range, the "MAD d"
of a component's), so a noisy case does not flag its own jitter. `gated`
metrics are the regressions a report leads with; a `derived` metric repeats
another and is not compared. Kernel object size excludes the harness and
In two nightlies of one commit, cycles moved by well under 1%, npu_us by 17%
at the 90th percentile on npu1, where one case's MAD was 21% of its median.
The rest are the component checks'. In three back-to-back runs of one commit
on an npu2, mobilenet's per-image and streaming times moved by up to 3.8%, its
end-to-end time by 6.4% and its compile time by 3.7%. In three sweeps, every
seed's placement cost was identical, the mean CPU time moved by 1.6%, the
slowest seed's by 18%, and peak memory by under 1%; the sweep runs on shared
hosted runners, so CPU time has room.
